website_summary.name: Fundraiser Day Promotional Portal
website_summary.description: The website is designed with a vibrant and inviting layout, featuring gradient colors and interactive sections to promote a fundraising event.
website_summary.appearance:
The website features a clean and modern design with a gradient background transitioning from rose to amber tones. At the top, there's a prominent header introducing the "Fundraiser Day" event with a bold title and a brief description. Below the header, there are three distinct sections: 
1. Offers: Highlighting exclusive deals, discounts, and early bird specials with colorful boxes and clear call-to-action buttons.
2. Testimonials: A section showcasing quotes from past fundraisers with their roles and photos, arranged in a horizontally scrollable carousel.
3. Company Information: A footer area providing details about Rise N' Shine Ltd, including contact information and links to various pages like About Us, Our Mission, and FAQ.
website_summary.functionality:
The website includes several functional elements:
1. Call-to-action buttons ("Start Shopping," "Learn More") encouraging users to engage further.
2. An automatically moving carousel for displaying offers, allowing users to view different promotions sequentially.
3. A testimonial section with a horizontal scroll feature for browsing through various user reviews.
4. A footer with links to additional pages and contact details for the organization.
